summary: 30 juin : EARLY RISK-OFF 6e session (VIX 17.65, S&P 7,440). Monday ceasefire rally +1.18% masks ERO persistence at 44.6%. Gold RSI 33 near oversold. BTC $59,419 just 2.3% above 52W low. Qatar talks today. NKE/STZ earnings tonight. NFP Thursday in holiday-shortened week. Sizing 0.75x.

risks.label: ERO 6th consecutive session — regime not flipping despite rally
risks.detail: Ensemble model shows ERO probability 44.6%, risk_on only 10.2%. Monday's S&P +1.18% bounce is tech-driven (NASDAQ +2.07%) without breadth confirmation (only 49.6% positive). Safe-haven flows persist (gold $4,003, 10Y at 4.37%). Breakout strategy blocked, sizing reduced to 0.75x.

risks.label: US-Iran ceasefire fragility — 3rd iteration in 10 days
risks.detail: Qatar talks today (Tuesday). Third ceasefire attempt in 10 days. Oil barely reacted (-0.72%), indicating market fatigue. If talks collapse, expect $3-5 WTI spike and 50-100pt S&P sell-off. Strait of Hormuz remains contested despite official reopening.

risks.label: Gold RSI 33 — approaching oversold territory
risks.detail: Gold at $4,003 with RSI 33.2 is the most oversold since April. GLD $368.58 is 9.5% below 50-day EMA ($404.76). Historically, RSI below 35 triggers mean-reversion bounces 65%+ of the time. A floor break below $3,950 could accelerate the decline.

risks.label: BTC $59,419 — just 2.3% above 52-week low
risks.detail: Bitcoin clings to $59,419, only $1,343 above the 52W floor at $58,076. ETH $1,587 also near 52W low ($1,507). Crypto disconnected from equity rally — structural selling pressure, no institutional bid. Break below $58K targets $52-55K.

risks.label: Holiday-shortened week — July 4 liquidity drain
risks.detail: Markets closed Friday July 3 for Independence Day. NFP moved to Thursday. Reduced volumes amplify volatility. Low-liquidity environments produce outsized moves on thin order books.

risks.label: Crisis probability 15.4% — declining but non-trivial
risks.detail: Ensemble crisis state at 15.4%, down from 26.9% prior session. Improvement driven by ceasefire, but remains above the sub-10% levels of May. Combined with ERO dominance, regime could deteriorate on any shock.

events.label: NKE Q4 & STZ Q1 earnings tonight (AMC)
events.detail: Nike Q4 2026 (consensus EPS $0.13, $61.4B market cap) and Constellation Brands Q1 2027 (EPS $3.17, $23.9B) report after close. NKE is a consumer spending bellwether — guidance matters more than the quarter. STZ tracks premiumization trends.

events.label: S&P 500 rallied +1.18% on ceasefire — NASDAQ +2.07%
events.detail: S&P 7,440 (+1.18%), NASDAQ +2.07%, Dow +0.59%. Comm Services led (+4%) on Alphabet's Dow debut. Only 49.6% positive breadth — narrow tech-led rally. SPY reclaimed EMA20 ($739.78). Volume above average (56.8M).

events.label: Consumer Confidence & JOLTS data today
events.detail: Two labor/consumer data points today. Consumer confidence is a leading indicator for discretionary spending. JOLTS job openings measure labor market tightness — weaker number could support rate cut expectations.

events.label: NFP Thursday — pre-holiday timing amplifies reaction
events.detail: Non-Farm Payrolls Thursday (est. +123K vs +172K prior). Markets closed Friday, deferring true repricing to Monday July 6. Thin liquidity amplifies initial moves. Hot number cements hawkish Fed; miss below 100K revives recession fears.

events.label: FOMC Minutes + ISM Manufacturing Wednesday
events.detail: Double catalyst Wednesday: FOMC Minutes reveal internal debate around Warsh's hawkish tilt. ISM Manufacturing provides forward-looking growth signal. Both hit before holiday thin liquidity kicks in Thursday-Friday.

events.label: GIS earnings tomorrow BMO
events.detail: General Mills Q4 2026 (consensus EPS $0.80, $18.4B market cap) reports before market open Wednesday. Consumer staples earnings test the defensive rotation thesis.

opportunities.label: GLD mean reversion — RSI 33 oversold bounce setup
opportunities.detail: GLD at $368.58 with RSI 33.2, historically produces 65%+ bounce rate within 10 days. Entry $365-369, stop $358, TP1 $388 (EMA20), TP2 $405 (EMA50). Catalyst: Qatar talks failure or dollar softening. R:R 2.5:1.

opportunities.detail: Ameren Corp (AEE), scanner score 100. Regulated utility with RSI 59.8, above all MAs. Momentum strategy in ERO regime = defensive growth. Entry $114.59, stop $110.58, TP1 $123.01.

opportunities.detail: Novartis (NVS), scanner score 100. RSI 63.7 strongest momentum. Healthcare defensive in ERO. Entry $157.59, stop $152.07, TP1 $169.18. EU geographic diversification.
